about: Text the mod adds to Brotato (English; Brotato falls back to English for other languages). Mum's letters are NOT here: they come from Hue's own HueText table in the player's language.

rows.en: Hold [Right Click / Space / Trigger] to open Hue's colour wheel. Enemies and bullets the colour of the background vanish: they can't hurt you, and you can't hurt them.
Starts with Aqua and Purple. A new colour fragment appears every other wave until all 8 are found.
Each colour fragment brings one of Mum's letters, read aloud.
Hue: colour fragments heal 25% of your max HP
Hue: switching colour gives 1 material per enemy revealed (max 5, once a second)
Hue: enemies you reveal are slowed by 40%
Hue: switching colour heals 2 HP (once every 2 seconds)
Hue's laser cannons orbit you, joined by laser beams in the colours you've found. A beam the colour of the background vanishes, leaving a gap.
Hold Right Click / Space / Trigger: colour wheel   Q/E: switch   G: grey
Hue Potato needs Hue installed (Steam). Install Hue, then restart Brotato: the mod reads Hue's art, music and Mum's letters from your copy.
Switch to a laser's colour to walk through it
Switch to a boulder's colour to let it roll through you
